title: Bolus requested through WearOS is not executed
symptom: After confirming the desired bolus on WearOS, a toast indicates 'treatment requested', but the treatment is never executed while close to the phone. No confirmation message is received on the watch and nothing happens in the app on the phone.
cause: The issue was resolved after passing objective 3, but a maintainer stated that objectives are independent of bolus administration through WearOS. The exact cause is not clearly established.
fix: The user reported that it is working now after passing objective 3, but the maintainer said it's an independent thing. No specific fix was provided.
evidence_quote: It is working now. The only thing that I can think of that has changed is that I passed objective 3.
